title: Partial review of c10's slow-D twins finding: part (2), fch-metabolic, replicates on fresh seed 9 (no gate, Dc=0.01: 46/46 founder lineages alive, 22 persistent splits, 54 vs 61 bodies with the shell); parts (1) and (3) not checked; Supported for (2)
summary: My labkit runs of fch-metabolic on new seed 9 (made for 20261025T1149-c04-review-no-shell-needed; copies in rerun/) test part (2) of this finding directly: world_nogate_Dc0.01.py (beta=0, catalyst D lowered 100x) against the full gated world. No gate, Dc=0.01: 46/46 founder lineages alive from t=200 to 800, bodies 46 -> 54, 26 splits, 22 persistent, generation 2, 0 merges, catalyst contrast 24-39x with every body >= 2x. Full world: 26/26 alive, 26 -> 61 bodies, 25 persistent splits, generation 2 (fork_seed9.txt, summary_seed9.txt). This matches the finding's seed-23 numbers (41/42 alive, 22 persistent splits, 54 vs 65 bodies). I did not run parts (1) fch-gated-micelles or (3) fch-chemoton.

observations.E: fork_seed9.txt: no gate, Dc=0.01 keeps 46/46 founder lineages alive to t=800 (full world 26/26)
observations.D: rerun/ng9/lineage.png: 22 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges; bodies 54 vs 61 with the shell

seeds_run.result: fail: non-finite fields at frame 1 in both arms

verdicts.limitation: Only part (2) of three is checked, on one fresh seed, with runs I also used for the review of c07's matching finding, so this is not independent of that review. The general reading (exp gate matched by a uniform slowdown; min-face gate tied to the bilayer not matched) rests on parts I did not rerun.
